note: Parked. 2026-09-05 ensure-widgets run: registered bundle id com.moodmixformat.mixbase.widgets (H5ZAGZG4UL) and enabled APP_GROUPS on it and on com.moodmixformat.mixbase. REMAINING BLOCKER (outside any API's reach): the app group group.com.moodmixformat.mixbase itself must be registered and assigned to BOTH App IDs with an Apple ID session — the public ASC API has no appGroups resource (GET /v1/appGroups → 404) and Xcode's API-key cloud signing fails 'Authentication failed' on every profile request involving the group. One-time fix: developer.apple.com → Identifiers → App Groups → register the group, then edit both App IDs' App Groups capability to assign it; a local Xcode build of the iOS app on the Mac (logged-in Apple ID, automatic signing) does the same automatically. After that, TestFlight runs mint profiles normally again.
